header.topicFallback: Build your site, text, images, and launch from one window.

firstRun.title: Create a site and bring it to publication
firstRun.description: Start with the idea and style, then prepare page drafts and images, launch the storefront and manage the site right from the desktop.
firstRun.briefPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this site is, who it is for, what makes it different and which communication style you want.
firstRun.outcomeDescription: One clear path: from idea and drafts to a published storefront, content management and safe site deletion.
firstRun.outcomeAssistant: The assistant prepares page structure, copy, SEO basics and image prompts.
firstRun.outcomePublic: The public storefront opens separately from your desktop, while site data stays in an isolated environment.
firstRun.outcomeAdmin: Content and orders are managed only inside the desktop, without a second login and without exposing private admin pages to visitors.
firstRun.outcomeReview: You review drafts first, then explicitly apply them to the site and start publication.
